{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse, loose fit, knee length, emerald green (#049A2B), silk.
Tailored wool trousers, straight cut, ankle length, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy wool.
Leather loafers, pointed toe, mid-ankle height, dark brown (#4B3621), smooth calfskin.
Gold geometric earrings, medium size, polished gold, 18k vermeil.
This outfit works because the rich emerald silk blouse captures the festive New Year spirit while remaining appropriate for an upscale restaurant setting. The structured charcoal wool trousers elevate the look from casual everyday wear to a polished smart ensemble suitable for evening celebrations. Warm leather loafers provide both comfort and sophistication, bridging the gap between the frosty weather outside and the warm interior without needing an outer coat that would break the silhouette."}
